title: Due on Receipt as the default shows only Move Customers
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Due on Receipt is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Make sure at least one customer holds Due on Receipt.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps: 1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "Due on Receipt" row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu shows exactly these items, in this order: "Move Customers" (person).
  • Nothing else shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-R1: “Each row's "⋯" menu shows only the items that apply to that term, in this order. An item that applies but is blocked shows greyed out and does nothing when clicked; hovering it shows the reason.”
  • S2-N2: “COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold never show "Deactivate" (S1-R9 explains why on the lock icon).”
  • S2-N4: “The current default never shows "Make Default for New Customers"; its "Deactivate" and, for a term the shop created, "Delete Credit Term" show blocked with the default reason (S2-R1).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
